name: ChipMango
what_they_do: Semiconductor education and chip-design services startup offering an AI-powered learning platform with cloud EDA tool access, university training partnerships, and ASIC/FPGA design engineering services. Founded in 2022, it partners with Nigerian universities (UNILAG, OAU, Miva) and global firms like Arm, Cadence, and Synopsys.
recent_activity: 2026-09-01: Raised $1.9M seed round led by Atlantica Ventures (https://chipmango.com/newsroom/chipmango-raises-19-million-to-expand-semiconductor-talent-and-design-capability) | 2026-08-03: Launched chip design training program in Uganda with Lwera (https://chipmango.com/newsroom/chipmango-lwera-launch-chip-design-training-program-for-engineering-students-in-uganda) | 2026-07-31: Launched sponsored Chip Design & Edge AI programs with AI UniPod UNILAG (https://chipmango.com/newsroom/chipmango-ai-unipod-unilag-launch-fully-sponsored-chip-design-edge-ai-training-programs)
investors: Atlantica Ventures (lead), Madica, DFS Lab, Kaleo Ventures, Trilinear Technologies, Malta Venture Capital
